fixed_locations.why: _extract_scheme_and_domain and _check_in_allowed_domain compare the url's scheme and host with the allowlist
validate_limit_to_domains refuses to build the chain without an allowlist
the model-written url is checked against limit_to_domains before the sync fetch
the same check before the async fetch
the app restricts the chain to the configured weather API base

negative_analyses.rationale: The model still writes the url, but the chain raises before fetching unless the scheme and host equal the configured weather API base. A url pointing at the metadata service or any other internal host is refused, so the model can no longer choose where the server sends requests.
Because only the public forecast API can be fetched, api_response can only hold public forecast data. No internal response reaches the answer prompt, the model provider or the end user.

evidence.upstream_fix_summary: Added a mandatory limit_to_domains allowlist to APIChain and a scheme plus domain check before both the sync and async request.
